title: Born of the Gods: card flavor text

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A Planeswalker chosen on Theros who speaks of leading by example and opposes Xenagos.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A Planeswalker on Theros who speaks of Thassa and is mistaken by a follower for Thassa herself.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A Planeswalker known as the Nightmare Weaver, who speaks of nightmares as caged birds.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr who has become the god of revels, called a false god by Elspeth.

entities.name: Olexa of the Twelve
entities.description: A Theran speaker who says civilization is the sum of Ephara's gifts.

entities.name: Hypatia of the Winged Horse
entities.description: A rider who trusts her pegasus never to let her fall.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: The king of Akros.

entities.name: Uremides
entities.description: A philosopher who foresees gods shuddering at mortals.

entities.name: Prokopios
entities.description: An astronomer of Meletis.

entities.name: Lindos
entities.description: A merchant of Meletis who doubts the use of praying to Thassa.

entities.name: Thrasios
entities.description: A triton hero who speaks of Thassa's anger.

entities.name: Agathe
entities.description: A priest of Pharika who speaks of poisons.

entities.name: Perisophia
entities.description: A philosopher who speaks of the whip of Erebos and of undone lives.

entities.name: Anthousa of Setessa
entities.description: A Setessan who vows to track those who take children.

entities.name: Eocles
entities.description: An oracle of Purphoros who ponders Maikal's rage.

entities.name: Maikal
entities.description: A man blessed by Purphoros, known for his rage.

entities.name: Igalus
entities.description: A king whose last words were about a slain gorgon.

entities.name: Daeron
entities.description: A brave man whose courage brought him to Odunos and whom the magic of Meletis brought home.

entities.name: Alkmenos
entities.description: A proud man who would not bow to Erebos in death and is now bowed for all eternity.

entities.name: Plidius
entities.description: A man who wagered Arissa could not kill a chimera with javelins alone.

entities.name: Arissa
entities.description: A javelin thrower who killed a chimera spectacularly.

entities.name: Althemone
entities.description: A young companion of the Champion who doubted she could defeat a cyclops with one spear.

entities.name: The Champion
entities.description: The hero of The Theriad, chosen by Heliod's sacred hart, who fought a cyclops and trained with a centaur.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God of the sun on Theros.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead on Theros who wields a whip.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the sea on Theros.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of the forge, of creation and destruction.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God of storms and epiphany.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: A god whose gifts are tied to civilization.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: A god served by priests who know poisons and balms.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God of the hunt.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: The harvest god.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: A god who promised the newly dead they would be spared from Erebos.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods and mortals where this set takes place.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A militant city of Theros whose walls have blades.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A scholarly city of Theros whose walls have ears.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A city of Theros with warriors of Leina Tower.

entities.name: Mount Sulano
entities.description: A mountain that erupted in anger.

entities.name: Dakra Isles
entities.description: Isles few dare to brave.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The realm of the dead, ruled by Erebos.

entities.name: Odunos
entities.description: A place Daeron's bravery brought him to.

entities.name: Pheres-Band
entities.description: A centaur warrior band whose trompers are feared.

entities.name: Felhide minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs with burial rites involving devouring the fallen.

entities.name: The Theriad
entities.description: A written epic about the Champion of the Sun.

events.summary: The Champion lays down her weapons and approaches the great hart, which bows to her, marking her as the Chosen of the Sun God.
events.quote: The hart, sacred to Heliod and bathed in the god's own light, bowed to the Champion, marking her as the Chosen of the Sun God.

events.summary: The Champion faces a cyclops with a single spear, reasoning that it has but one eye, while young Althemone doubts her.
events.quote: The Champion raised her weapon. "It has but one eye."

events.summary: As a girl, the future Champion of the Sun is taught by a centaur to make peace with her anger.
events.quote: "I will teach you the ways of war, child. But first you must make peace with yourself."

events.summary: Phenax promises the newly dead they will be spared from Erebos.
events.quote: Phenax promised the newly dead souls they would be spared from Erebos.
Mount Sulano erupted not in magma but in anger.

events.summary: Daeron's bravery brings him to Odunos and the magic of Meletis brings him home.
events.quote: It was Daeron's bravery that brought him to Odunos.

events.summary: Plidius wagers that Arissa cannot kill a chimera with javelins alone; she does.
events.quote: Plidius wagered that Arissa couldn't kill a chimera with her javelins alone.

events.summary: Alkmenos, who refused to bow to Erebos in death, is bowed for eternity.
events.quote: Proud Alkmenos, who would not bow to Erebos in death, is now bowed by his own hubris for all eternity.

events.summary: King Igalus dies with last words asking to see a slain gorgon.

relations.note: Elspeth calls Xenagos a false god who threatens Theros.
relations.quote: "The false god Xenagos treats the whole world as his rollick site.

relations.note: A follower believes Kiora is Thassa.
relations.quote: "She may call herself Kiora but I believe she is Thassa, the embodiment of the sea and empress of the depths."

relations.note: Agathe is a priest of Pharika.
Eocles is an oracle of Purphoros.
relations.quote: Did Purphoros bless Maikal because of his rage?
